# Muse of Seoul
> K-beauty insider Blog — your guide to beauty clinics, tours, and honest local tips in Seoul.

## Categories
- K-Beauty Treatments: /category/beauty — Clinics, skincare treatments, and honest reviews.
- K-Beauty Products: /category/k-beauty — Product reviews and what's actually worth buying.
- Stay in Seoul: /category/stay — Hotels and neighborhoods to base yourself in.
- Where to Go in Seoul: /category/where-to-go — Neighborhood guides, cafes, and restaurants worth the trip.
